metadata.description: Self-hosted marketplace for the project-reviewer Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: project-reviewer
plugins.description: Qualitative multi-agent project review: project-level tech-stack-fit assessment with per-technology depth (primary) plus per-file 3-criteria findings (secondary), rendered as a self-contained HTML report. Default scope is backend + AI; frontend is opt-in. Per-target isolation. Does not build/run/test code.
